name: Kad Sketcher
description: The CAD.LIKE.AUDIO bundle. One build, two entrances named in the fragment: #/drawing opens the sketch — lines, true arcs, dimensions, DXF export — and #/big-picture opens the model, where Flow blocks carry typed ports that are read out of the APK:OS Interfaces Terminals table rather than coined. An unrecognised fragment lands on the drawing board, so a bookmark from before the split still works. scripts/verifyFlow.ts asserts the port geometry, the neighbour graph and the DXF BLOCK/INSERT resolution on every build.
